title: Gaussian measure of differing halflines
statement: Let $\gamma$ be the standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R$ and let $\Phi(t)=\gamma((-�\infty,t])$ be its distribution function. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the Gaussian measure of the symmetric difference of the halflines $(-\infty,a]$ and $(-\infty,b]$ is $|\Phi(b)-\Phi(a)|$.
hypotheses_covered: standard Gaussian measure and its distribution function
